The class diagram records setup, run-time ownership, bunch data, the
`CartesianPIC3D` implementation, IPPL Poisson adapters, and the `FFT2D5`
implementation. The flow diagram follows one requested space-charge update
from `ParallelTracker` through algorithm dispatch, field solution, coordinate
restoration, and diagnostic accounting.

The editable Mermaid versions and a concise architecture overview are in the
[Space-Charge Solver Architecture](../../../developer-guide/space-charge-solver-architecture.html)
chapter.
